figures.heading: New Vendor today
captions: Captured on the branch build at localhost:8080; the dialog layout is unchanged from production. In production the picker lists the 12 standard terms only.

texts.text: Captured on the branch build at localhost:8080; the dialog layout is unchanged from production. In production the picker lists the 12 standard terms only.

figures.heading: New Vendor: starts on COD, picker with your terms
captions: A new vendor starts on COD, as today: the shop default applies to new customers only (VendorDialog.vue keeps COD).
One term list for customers and vendors: the picker offers the active terms in the S1-R5 order, Credit Hold last. Deactivated terms are not offered.
Credit Limit: vendors have a required Credit Limit field. The build does not apply the COD / Credit Hold $0 lock to vendors, so it stays editable on every term.
Source: VendorDialog.vue field layout, drawn with DS Text field, Select and Menus.
Names and counts are demo data and differ from the build screenshots; layout, wording and states match the build (canvas-check sheets in local-check).

figures.heading: A vendor invoice today (Net 60)
captions: Captured on the branch build: layout unchanged from production. Invoice Aug 31, Net 60, due Oct 30. The due date is worked out from the vendor's credit term when the vendor invoice is created, and recalculated when its invoice date or its vendor changes (S7-R9).

figures.heading: Vendor on 10th of next month: Oct 5, due Nov 10
captions: Same date rule as customer invoices: always the 10th of the next month; a shorter month uses its last day.
The highlight marks what to check; it is not part of the screen.
Source: Delivery.vue layout (Vendor Invoice card, Delivery Details, Delivery items), drawn with DS Card and Table.
Names and counts are demo data and differ from the build screenshots; layout, wording and states match the build (canvas-check sheets in local-check).
